title: Draft Gratuity Chapter V source-readiness mapping
sourceGaps: Qualified review is still required for Chapter V interpretation, First Schedule customer applicability and State or Union Territory implementation.
Customer establishment classification, employee-count history and workforce category are not independently verified and are not provider inputs.
Individual continuous service, wages, fixed-term status, nomination, forfeiture, insurance, claims, disputes, appeals and recovery are outside this pack.
Competent/appellate authority notifications and State-specific instruments may be onboarded later as bounded source identities; they are not needed to create individual outcomes in Wave 5D.
